title: Decision Counseling and Follow-up for Shield+ Patients
official: Decision Counseling and Follow-up (DCaF) for Shield+ Patients
summary: Prospective, observational, minimal-risk study evaluating decision-making, decisional conflict, intention to undergo complete diagnostic evaluation (CDE), and colonoscopy completion after a positive Shield TM blood-based colorectal cancer screening test result.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participant is 45-75 years old at the time of ShieldTM test order.
* Participant has a valid Shield(+) test result.
* Participant is willing and able to complete the informed consent process
* Participant is able to complete the informed consent process and decision counseling session in English

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participant is already enrolled in another Guardant Health, Inc. clinical study or has received a positive MCD result for a cancer type other than CRC.
